questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

110 + 54 × 9 − 13 ÷ 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 110 + 54 × 9 - 13 ÷ 2 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-’ are interchanged, and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 110 - __**54 ÷ 9**__ + __**13 × 2**__ = ?

⇒ 110 __**- 6 + 26**__ = ?

⇒ 110 + 20

⇒ __**130**__

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All Excels are Words.

All Words are PowerPoints.

Conclusions:

(I) All PowerPoints are Excels.

(II) At least some Words are Excels.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

All Excels are Words.

All Words are PowerPoints.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f2f0a1a5bee0b9e7c8ba08ee52ae63d6b317eb8b6239d4d190424dcdf07c471.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All PowerPoints are Excels - **False**(Because, all excels are words and all words are PowerPoint, it implies that some PowerPoint are excels not all).

(II) At least some Words are Excels - **True**(Because, ll Excels are Words, it implies that same words are excels).

Thus, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

Statements:

All bats are mammals.

No mammal is a fish.

Conclusions:

(I) No bat is a fish.

(II) Some fishes are mammals.
questions.solution:

(I) No bat is a fish - **True**(because, all bats are mammal and no mammal is fish, it implies that no bat is fish).

(II) Some fishes are mammals - False(because, no mammal is fish, it implies that no fish is mammal).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
